memory_update.text: For the AI data-center power/cooling/grid node, prioritize VRT and ETN as direct equipment suppliers; PWR, EME, and FIX as construction/interconnection execution capacity; GEV and POWL as power/grid equipment; and CEG as firm low-carbon power exposure.

The node should be split into at least four sub-baskets for follow-up: inside-the-data-center electrical/thermal equipment, grid/transmission construction, power-generation equipment, and generation/utility assets with credible data-center load exposure.

Further expansion should test additional US-listed names in transformers, switchgear, wire/cable, HVAC/chillers, water systems, backup generation, fuel cells, data-center REITs, and regulated utilities with high interconnection activity.

AI-specific exposure is not proven by data-center product pages alone; next layer must verify backlog, customer disclosures, end-market mix, pricing power, lead times, and whether demand is incremental versus already priced/cyclical.
